verdict.rationale: An official SDK is a fair question for a hosted agent product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no Grok Bot SDK or API. The only developer surface found, the OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai, documents xAI's separate model REST API and contains zero Grok Bot paths. The runtime probe also found no public Grok Bot API, CLI, or MCP endpoint; the product is driven only through its own apps.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
